message: An OIDC workspace mapping can now grant a granular role. Adding granular_role to a workspace_mappings entry restricts the member to the operations of the named role declared in BASEROW_ROLES, so an IdP group decides both which workspaces a user lands in and what they may do there. If the named role does not exist the membership is refused rather than granted unrestricted access, and dropping granular_role from a mapping restores full member access on the next login.
